scientific_integrity: All line cuts are covered by a two-parameter classification after symmetry. The proof uses exact centroid and projection formulas and exact polynomial inequalities. Symbolic computation only replays the displayed algebra and is not used to infer an infinite statement from sampling.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to one straight-line truncation of an equilateral triangle. The threshold is an infimum because the limiting cut has degenerate equilibria. It does not compute unrestricted full robustness, average robustness, or values for regular polygons with more sides.
title: Exact one-line downward robustness of the equilateral triangle
